params.1273:
Wield the bronze armour and weapon you have acquired.

For more information on this Task, click on the Hints tab above.
params.1292: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.
params.1274: To wear an object, right-click on it in your inventory and choose 'Wear' or 'Wield'.
params.1275: Most weapons and armour can be equipped by simply left-clicking on them in your inventory.
params.1276: You can see what you are currently wearing, and what effect it has on your character, via the Worn Equipment tab on the side bar.
